notes: The two failures are discriminating and the fixes are mechanical: the six lint findings are all in the agent's new prose (HEAD files lint clean), and the AGENTS.md edit is a benign index tweak the fixture's own rules did not require. Two assertions are looser than they look: assertion 2 asks for a 'Non-goals section' and a 'one-paragraph intro', which cannot be checked literally when the agent amends an existing file (here a labelled paragraph did the job), so the eval should say what form counts in the amend case; assertion 12 would also fail a run that correctly updated AGENTS.md for a brand-new spec file, which docs/README.md's 'When to update what' table requires, so it conflicts with the fixture for the new-file path. No assertion checks that the two Open-questions blocks reference a file inside the repo (the spec points at a questions.md that lives in OUTPUT_DIR), nor that the `overdue` line format is defined as identical to `list` (CLI-011 does this well, uncaught by any assertion). Assertion 3's 'one to three sentences' is silently stretched by CLI-010's example caption plus code block; if examples are welcome, say so.
